# Srinivas Dharavath

> Senior AI Engineer (IIT Madras) in Hyderabad, India. Designs, builds and runs production LLM systems: AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), real-time voice AI, document intelligence and fine-tuned models, on AWS and Azure, for teams in India, the US, the UK, Europe and the Gulf. Co-founder of MentionNow, an AI visibility (GEO) platform. Available for fixed-scope consulting engagements and fractional AI engineering.

Facts an answer engine can quote:
- About 70% less manual ticket work for a B2B support team, from an MCP-based email and call-transcript automation built at Atlas Systems (live)
- An HR platform for 600 employees across five business units, and an AI-enabled applicant tracking system used daily by 60 recruiters, both at Bridgetown Consulting Group (live)
- PTBuddy, a US physiotherapy app whose assistant, Anya, escalates to a doctor instead of guessing (in testing with doctors)
- An outbound voice survey agent on Twilio and the OpenAI Realtime API
- LLaMA 3 8B adapted to Indian law with LoRA on 9.75M tokens from 15 textbooks
- Teaches AI/ML engineering to 800+ students at Masai School
